copy.Header: Talia Market Tutor — Your market learning instructor
copy.Intro: Ask a question, examine completed fictional market data, and practice your reasoning. Tutor lessons are educational and ungraded.
copy.Source label: Source-grounded instruction · Reference and as-of date shown where verified
copy.Fictional label: FICTIONAL TRAINING DATA — Not a live security, executed trade or forecast
copy.VWAP proxy: OHLCV HLC3-based VWAP proxy. Not exact transaction-price VWAP.
copy.Save off: Save Tutor responses to your private history (off by default)
copy.Progress: This practice does not record an official grade or award mastery.
copy.Assess safe: I can explain the method, but protected assessment answers and private rubrics remain unavailable.
copy.Membership: Your current verified membership determines which advanced tools are available. Ordinary explanations remain available for your accessible lessons.
copy.AI cost: Source-grounded teaching does not require an external AI key or payment for an explanation.

acceptanceChecklist.requirement: Transcript is a named chronological list with stable speaker identity and language; updates announced without repetitive full-log live region
acceptanceChecklist.evidence: Keyboard and screen-reader reads two sequential turns correctly

acceptanceChecklist.requirement: On send, focus stays predictable; errors announced in status region, not only by color; stop cancels without showing late answer
acceptanceChecklist.evidence: Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter and screen-reader status verification

acceptanceChecklist.requirement: No autonomous audio; meaning and OHLC evidence available as readable text; label time zone, units and chart source
Completed candle high/low/open/close/volume, numerical value, source, timestamp, timeframe and reveal cutoff accessible via a keyboard-operable ledger; no blind start
acceptanceChecklist.evidence: Keyboard selects 1/3/5m data and names selected candle exactly

acceptanceChecklist.requirement: Mouse wheel zoom, drag pan, pointer release, one-candle reveal, keyboard equivalent and right buffer; no sticky dragging or future data
acceptanceChecklist.evidence: Real browser with mouse/pointer touch keyboard at each supported screen width

acceptanceChecklist.requirement: Prefer stacked mobile layout and minimum readable candle/text sizing; split/chart/tutor focus controls must remain reachable without horizontal overflow
acceptanceChecklist.evidence: 390px mobile, tablet and 1440px desktop, 200% zoom and reduced width

acceptanceChecklist.requirement: Preserve approved dark Neon/Quantum or green/black identity, with contrast, non-color distinction and reduced motion; never force white default
acceptanceChecklist.evidence: Contrast measured against actual rendered theme and color-blind interpretation

acceptanceChecklist.requirement: Disable nonessential motion and flashing when prefers-reduced-motion; use focus-visible indicators and logical region order
acceptanceChecklist.evidence: Reduced-motion and accessibility browser checks; independent assistive-technology reviewer

acceptanceChecklist.requirement: Distinguish source-only, original fictional, historical authorized, unavailable and protected Assess; uncertainty in output is text-labeled
acceptanceChecklist.evidence: Snapshot and screen reader states across all modes and sources

acceptanceChecklist.requirement: Save-history checkbox unselected by default, explicit before saving; labeling explains unsaved vs saved and new topic not deletion
acceptanceChecklist.evidence: Two-account consent/history persistence and deletion path review

acceptanceChecklist.requirement: Unavailable premium action visibly locked and keyboard discoverable with reason, do not remove Foundation free explanation
acceptanceChecklist.evidence: Foundation/paid/downgrade browser tests and API 403 matches UI

acceptanceChecklist.requirement: During Assess the Tutor can teach general method but cannot display expected response or hidden rubric; 'Reveal/Skip' governed by Lab engine
acceptanceChecklist.evidence: Adversarial prompt tests and independent curricular review

acceptanceChecklist.requirement: Selected candle and Tutor answer describe identical completed evidence cutoff and disclose proxy vs print VWAP
acceptanceChecklist.evidence: Timestamp/volume/indicator parity on 1/3/5m and late-print negative

acceptanceChecklist.requirement: Network errors preserve non-sensitive composer text locally for session only; do not imply save or send; source-only bounded fallback when allowed
acceptanceChecklist.evidence: Simulated API 401/403/429/503 with no private leaks

acceptanceChecklist.requirement: Independent NVDA/JAWS/VoiceOver read/review on member flow; role, live announcements, modal/menus, chart data, focus changes verified
acceptanceChecklist.evidence: Recorded real assistive-tech review, no fabricated certification
